header.running_head: Showing Mercy To Children and Treating them with Equality

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ was in Sajdah, Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA) would come and climb on his back. Rasulullaah ﷺ would then prolong the Sajdah. When asked why the Sajdah was prolonged, Rasulullaah ﷺ would reply, "When my two (grand) children mounted my back, I did not like to get up to quickly."[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Performs Salaah with Hadhrat Umaamah (RA) on his shoulders

Hadhrat Abu Qataadah (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once came out of his room with (his granddaughter) Hadhrat Umaamah bint Abil Aas (RA) on his shoulders. He then proceeded to perform salaah. He put her down whenever he went into Ruku and then picked her up again whenever he stood up (from Sajdah).[^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Carries Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA) on his shoulders and his Statement about them

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once came out to them with Hadhrat Hasan (RA) on one shoulder and Hadhrat Husayn (RA) on the other. He was kissing the one and then the other in turn when someone asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! You seem to love them very much?" Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Whoever loves them loves me and whoever hates them hates me."[^4]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Sucks the Tongue of Hadhrat Hasan (RA)

Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) once said, "I have seen Rasulullaah ﷺ suck his tongue (the tongue of Hadhrat Hasan bin Ali (RA)) and the tongue or lips that Rasulullaah ﷺ sucked can never suffer any punishment."[^5]
